title: GoHighLevel Automation Expert Needed for Coaching Business
description: We run a high ticket coaching business doing about $4M/yr. We have 6 closers and 3 setters working leads out of GoHighLevel. Our speed to lead is terrible and nobody knows which setter sourced which closed deal. Looking for someone who can rebuild our pipeline structure, set up round robin assignment, and build a commission tracker. Zapier experience required.

title: High Ticket Closer Wanted - $15k/mo Coaching Offer
description: Scaling our sales team from 4 to 12 closers over the next quarter. You will be taking 15-20 booked calls per week selling a $15k coaching program. Commission only, uncapped. We book the calls, you close them.
